# MediaPipe face detector model

`blaze_face_short_range.tflite` is the MediaPipe Face Detector "BlazeFace (short range)" model,
copied unchanged from
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_detector/blaze_face_short_range/float16/1/blaze_face_short_range.tflite
(SHA-256 b4578f35940bf5a1a655214a1cce5cab13eba73c1297cd78e1a04c2380b0152f).

It is hosted on this site because storage.googleapis.com is unreachable for many visitors in
mainland China. MediaPipe and its models are released by Google under the Apache License 2.0;
see `LICENSE.txt` in this folder.
